title: Clock Tower
shortDescription: Patient gears count the hours beneath an empty bell frame.
longDescription:
The stair coils around a timber spine polished by generations of paws and hands. Brass gears turn with the solemn concentration of beetles; every seventh tooth has been painted blue by someone who clearly lost count.
Above the clock face hangs an empty bell frame. Wind moves through its ropes, but the deep humming comes from the timber beneath your feet. A tighter stair continues down.

fixtures.name: Empty Bell Frame
fixtures.examineDescription: The frame has no bell and no clapper. The ropes are dry. Press the supporting oak and three slow pulses rise from below. The sound is not a swing. Something under the tower is answering the wood, and Alder wants that written down.
